name: Coolify
author: Luca Nerlich
description: Shows deployment activity across your Coolify servers: running and queued deployments in the bar, with current and recent deployments per application in the panel. Requires ~/.config/coolify-qs/config.json.

barWidget.description: Running and queued deployments across your Coolify servers, with a per-application deployment list.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Hide the widget entirely when no deployment is running or queued on any server.
